issue.title: Highlights sync renders the page-1 marker mirror as an annotation when the sidecar has a setext title preamble
issue.description:
Found while researching a `bob highlights` -> `bob ref` read surface (agents reading Bryan's annotations).

Highlights' current Markdown sidecar export starts with a setext title preamble before the first page heading, e.g. `lib/blogs/steve_kinney_agent_memory.md`:

```
Memory Systems for AI Agents: ... | Steve Kinney
================================================

#### [Page 1](highlights://steve_kinney_agent_memory#page=1)

##### 2026-06-03:

- status: wip
- parent: memory_ref
- url: https://stevekinney.com/writing/agent-memory-systems

***
```

The generated region of `ref/blogs/steve_kinney_agent_memory.md` then renders the page-1 PDF marker as if it were one of Bryan's annotations:

```
### Page 1

> [!note] - status: wip
> - parent: memory_ref
> - url: https://stevekinney.com/writing/agent-memory-systems

^h-a135b63accaf
```

Repro (read-only, on athena's vault):

```
cd ~/bob
rg -l -U '\[!note\] [-*] status: \w+\n> [-*] parent:' ref | wc -l      # 113
rg -l '^highlights_count: [1-9]' ref | wc -l                           # 115
```

All 113 affected notes have a sidecar whose line 2 is a setext `===` underline; of the 2 unaffected annotated notes, one has no setext preamble. Likely root cause (not yet confirmed by a unit test): `render_sidecar_highlights` / `annotation_tasks` skip only the *first* annotation for which `is_sidecar_marker_mirror` is true (`skipped_marker_note` one-shot in `src/native/highlights_ref/sidecar_render.rs` ~L30 and `annotation_tasks.rs` ~L18), and every `StandaloneNote` qualifies. The setext title (and author line with a `---` underline, which is also a spacer) appears to parse as a standalone-note chunk that consumes the one-shot skip, so the real marker list becomes the second standalone note and renders. Fixture `tests/fixtures/highlights_ref/linked_sidecar.md` has no setext preamble, so tests do not cover this shape.

Note the leaked mirror is the marker as Highlights last exported it, so it is often stale (`status: wip` / `ready` on notes whose real status is `read`).

task_type_fields.impact: 113 of 115 annotated reference notes show a fake, often stale "status/parent" note as an annotation; `highlights_count` is inflated by one for each; any agent or command that reads annotations (the planned `bob ref show` / annotation export) would surface it as Bryan's own note. The fix also needs a decision on vault churn: removing the block would tombstone `^h-...` IDs under "Removed highlights" in ~113 notes unless the mirror block is dropped silently.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching a bob ref annotation-read surface: nearly every annotated ref note contains a fake marker annotation that agents would misread as Bryan's own note.

payload.entry: Resolved by phase bob-cli-4w.8 (sync-fixes): content-based marker-mirror detection via region::is_marker_mirror_text, sidecar preamble skip, silent drop of leaked blocks without tombstones, and close-date stamping. Verified by new unit tests (setext_preamble_*, leaked_mirror_and_preamble_blocks_drop_silently_*) and CLI tests (highlights_ref_sync_drops_leaked_mirror_without_tombstone, close/cancel date stamping). Full CLI suite 1047/1047 green.

evidence.note:
Variant the 4r fix missed: Highlights sidecars grouped by COLOR rather than by page. They have no page heading at all, so no preamble is recognized.

Repro (2026-10-15, installed bob and current master ba71710, both after the close):
`bob ref show ref/chat/remote_sase_agents_consolidated.md -f json` still returns a `kind: note` annotation, `page_label: null`, block h-0803707b4f20, with comment:
"「remote_sase_agents_consolidated」 =================================\n\n- status: wip\n- parent: sase_ref\n- agent: research.final-11"
`ref/chat/apollo_remote_agents_workspace_topology.md` has the same shape. Both notes were re-synced on 2026-10-07 06:30 (vault commit f775fd7a, the post-fix sweep), and the block survived it.

Sidecar head (`lib/chat/remote_sase_agents_consolidated.md`): the `「…」` setext title + `===` underline, then `#### Yellow` (a color heading, not a page heading), `##### 2026-06-06:`, the marker list, then `***`. Every highlight in these exports has `page_label: null`.

Root cause (from reading the code): the title line is glued onto the marker chunk. `region::is_marker_mirror_text` -> `marker::parse_marker` rejects line 1 ("expected '- key: value'"), so the mirror check returns false. Neither the preamble skip (it needs a page heading) nor the silent-drop path catches it.

Impact: the stale marker shows as Bryan's own standalone note in `bob ref show` (all formats), in the Mac Copy card's A/H output, and in `annotation_count`/`comment_count`. Found while planning the Bob Refs inspector highlights section (it deliberately keeps standalone notes out of the inspector).
